transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because my family and friends wanted me to come. We just keep fighting. They keep showing me these bank papers and saying they prove nothing was taken from me. But... I mean, for over a year now, I've known that they're hiding my money. 

They try to use things like regular bills, or these fundraisers, and even plans for trips just to cover it all up. It's so obvious to me. So I just have to keep confronting them about it. I'm not going to stop until they finally tell the truth.
Do you think it's possible that your family and friends are telling the truth about your money?

No, I don't think it's possible at all. Like I said, for over a year I've known exactly what they're doing. They keep waving those bank papers in my face, saying it proves nothing was taken, but it's just a cover-up. 

They use all these things—regular bills, those fundraisers they talk about, even making up plans for trips—just to hide where my money is actually going. It's clear as day to me. That's why I came in, because they just won't admit it. I'm not going to stop confronting them until they finally tell the truth.
Do you think anyone else believes that your family and friends are hiding your money?

No, I don't think so. I mean... I haven't really found anyone who believes me. Everyone just takes their side. They look at those papers my family shows them and they just believe the lies. So, no, it's just me who sees what's actually going on.
Do you think people are hiding things from you or plotting against you in other areas of your life, beyond just your money?

No, it's really just the money. I mean... I haven't noticed them doing anything else to me. They aren't trying to hurt me or, you know, mess with my food or anything like that. It's just the money. That's the only thing they're lying about and trying to cover up. Everything else in my life is... well, it's fine, I guess. It's just this one big thing they won't admit to.
Have you ever had any doubts about your family and friends hiding your money?

No, I don't have any doubts. None at all. I mean... I know what I know. Like I was saying before, it's been over a year, and I know for a fact they are hiding my money. 

They can keep showing me those bank papers and making up excuses about bills or fundraisers or trips they're supposedly planning, but I know it's all just a cover-up. I don't doubt it for a second. That's the whole reason I came in here. I'm just going to keep confronting them until they finally tell the truth.
Has your belief that your family and friends are hiding your money ever changed or wavered since you first started thinking it?

No, not at all. Like I was just saying... it hasn't changed one bit. I came in here because my family and friends keep telling me those bank papers prove nothing was taken. But I've known for over a year now that they're hiding my money. They just use all these things... like bills, or fundraisers, or trips they say they're planning... they just use all that to cover it up. So, no, I haven't wavered. I just have to keep confronting them until they finally tell the truth.
Have you taken any actions because you believe your family and friends are hiding your money?

Well, yeah, I keep bringing it up to them. I mean, I have to, right? Because they won't admit it. But... because I keep asking about the money, things have changed. My relatives, they just avoid helping me with my bills now. And my friends... they used to include me in things, but now they've just stopped. They don't ask me to help with their fundraisers anymore, and they don't invite me on their travel plans. They just leave me out of it all because I won't stop asking them for the truth.
Have you ever stopped confronting your family and friends about the money for a while?

No, I never stopped. I mean, I can't stop. Like I keep telling you, they keep showing me those bank papers and saying it proves nothing was taken. But I've known for over a year that they are hiding my money. They just use their bills and their fundraisers and those trip plans to cover it all up. So no, I haven't taken a break from it. I have to keep confronting them until they finally tell the truth.
Has there ever been any evidence or information that could potentially change your mind about your family and friends hiding your money?

No, not really. I mean, like I've been saying, they think those bank papers are the evidence that should change my mind. They keep pointing at them and saying it proves nothing was taken. But it doesn't change anything for me, because I've known for over a year what they're really doing. The papers don't mean anything when they just use their regular bills, or those fundraisers, or their trips to hide where my money actually went. So no, nothing is going to make me think differently. I'm just gonna keep confronting them until they finally admit the truth.
Has there ever been a moment when you considered the possibility that your family and friends might be telling the truth about your money?

No, I haven't. I mean, why would I? Like I said, they keep shoving those bank papers in my face, telling me it proves they didn't take anything. But I know what's really going on. I've known for over a year that they're hiding my money. They just shuffle it around, using their bills and those fundraisers and their trip plans to cover their tracks. So no, I don't think they're telling the truth. I'm going to keep confronting them until they finally admit what they did.
Have you ever considered seeking a second opinion or an independent audit of your finances to verify your concerns?

No, I haven't. I don't... I'm not really sure what an audit is, honestly. But no, I haven't asked anyone else for a second opinion. 

I don't see why I would need to. I already know what they did, so I don't need some stranger coming in to look at things just to tell me what I already figured out. Getting someone else involved wouldn't really change anything anyway. So, no, I haven't done anything like that.
Do you think your belief about your family and friends hiding your money is based on facts or is it just a feeling you have?

It's facts. It's definitely facts, not just some feeling I have. 

I mean, they keep trying to say those bank papers prove nothing was taken, but... I know what's real. For over a year now, I've known that they're hiding my money. They just use their regular bills and those fundraisers and their trip plans to cover it all up. That's exactly what's happening, so it's not a feeling. It's just the truth. And I'm going to keep confronting them until they finally admit it.
